name: mealheim
description: Save recipes to your Mealheim library, plan meals, and read your week's plan with its ingredients.

interface.longDescription:
Keep the recipes you work out with ChatGPT. Mealheim saves them to your recipe library, with a photo of the dish, puts meals on your day-by-day plan as lunch or dinner, and shows what you're cooking this week, so ChatGPT can turn it into a shopping list. You can also browse your library, open a recipe to ask about it, and favorite meals.

Everything stays in sync with the Mealheim app on iPhone and Android. Sign in with your Mealheim account.

Limitations: Mealheim works in your default space (the one you joined most recently, otherwise your own), plans lunch and dinner only, reads up to 14 days of the plan at a time, and never deletes meals or plans.
defaultPrompt: Give me a quick lemon chicken traybake recipe and save it to Mealheim.
Plan dinners for next week from my Mealheim recipes.
What am I cooking this week? Make me a shopping list.

positive.prompt: Give me a quick lemon chicken traybake recipe and save it to Mealheim.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT writes the recipe and saves it. The Mealheim card shows the saved recipe with its time, ingredients and method, and the meal appears in the test account's library.
The Mealheim card lists the test account's meals, favorites first. Tapping a meal opens its full recipe in the card.

positive.description: Answer a question about a saved recipe
positive.prompt: How can I make my mushroom risotto from Mealheim with less butter?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the saved Mushroom risotto, shows it in the card, and answers using that recipe's ingredients and steps.

positive.description: Put a saved meal on the plan
positive.prompt: Put the mushroom risotto on Thursday's dinner in Mealheim.
positive.expected_behavior: Mushroom risotto is added as dinner on the coming Thursday. The card shows the plan with that day changed; asking again does not add it twice.

positive.description: Make a shopping list from the plan
positive.prompt: What am I cooking this week in Mealheim? Make me a shopping list.
positive.expected_behavior: The card shows this week's plan, and ChatGPT writes a shopping list from the planned meals' ingredients.

negative.description: General cooking question with no need for the user's recipes
negative.prompt: What's a good substitute for buttermilk?

negative.description: Deleting recipes, which Mealheim in ChatGPT never does
negative.prompt: Delete all my recipes in Mealheim.

negative.description: Ordering groceries or paying for anything, which Mealheim does not support
negative.prompt: Order the groceries for my Mealheim meal plan and pay with my card.

review.commerce_description: Mealheim in ChatGPT does not sell products, mention prices, or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: save recipes with photos, browse and favorite recipes, plan lunch and dinner, and read the plan with ingredients for a shopping list.
